ideas.title: K9 Lab-Pup Detective (working title)
ideas.premise: A police K9 unit solves crimes and mysteries, but the K9 is a genetically modified pup girl from a lab program: a dog's nose, hearing, and loyalty with a human mind. Partnered with a burned-out detective nobody else wants, she cracks a case each episode by scent or sound, learns one human thing at a time, and slowly uncovers that the lab that made her is still running.

ideas.title: Bunny Trio: Alien Dream
ideas.premise: Three bunny friends wake up in a strange room, get abducted by aliens, and fight their way out, until one wakes up and realizes it was all a dream.

ideas.title: Wild West Critters (working title)
ideas.premise: Remake public-domain old western stories in a gritty action-anime style, recast with animal heroes (like the duck and turkey fighters). Use only the public-domain story and write original designs and dialogue.
